description: Father and son team based in Chicago.
summary: Anwu vibe-coded a frontend website that includes two sections about Mars and the Moon. It also lists locations on Earth that have natural conditions that can be used to simulate their environments.
details: It is a frontend website made with HTML, CSS (Tailwind), & Javascript. It has a few interesting features but most importantly the Earth locations that analog Mars and the Moon. It is Anwu's first full website.
dataRefs: The website uses NASA data about the Moon and Mars.
